lines.japanese: 「ぬふん、無力な末弟が気休めを言ってくれる……だが礼は述べよう、いささかの希望が吹きかけられた」
lines.english: “Hrm. My powerless youngest brother offers words of consolation... Still, I shall thank you. You have breathed a little hope upon me.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう、良き風が来たな。貴様が呼んだのか？」
lines.english: “Ah. A favorable wind has come. Did you summon it?”

lines.japanese: 「うぉんむ、うぉんむ……これに乗れば、ひとまず奈落を脱することはできよう。光の向こうとまでは言わずとも、いまよりは格段に愚弟どもへ近づけるはずだ、素晴らしい」
lines.english: “Hrrm, hrrm... If we ride this, we should at least escape the abyss. It may not carry us beyond the light, but it ought to bring us vastly closer to my foolish brothers than we are now. Splendid.”

lines.japanese: 「いがいとおもしぇーかったよ」
lines.english: “It was more fun than I expected.”
